ja472:2.1: Yo ca appaṭivekkhitvā daṇḍaṃ kubbati khattiyo sakaṇṭakaṃ so gilati jaccandho va samakkhikaṃ.
ja472:3.1: Adaṇḍiyaṃ daṇḍiyati daṇḍiyañ ca adaṇḍiyaṃ andho va visamaṃ maggaṃ na jānāti samāsamaṃ.
ja472:4.1: Yo ca etāni ṭhānāni anuṃthūlāni sabbaso suddiṭṭhaṃ anusāseyya sa ve vohātum arahati.
ja472:5.1: N' ekantamudunā sakkā ekantatikhiṇena vā attaṃ mahante ṭhāpetuṃ, tasmā ubhayam ācare.
ja472:6.1: Paribhūto mudu hoti atitikkho ca veravā, etañ ca ubhayaṃ ñatvā anumajjhaṃ samācare.
ja472:7.1: Bahum pi ratto bhāseyya duṭṭho pi bahu bhāsati, na itthikāraṇā rāja puttaṃ ghātetum arahasīti.
ja472:8.1: Sabbo ca loko ekanto itthī ca ayam ekikā, tenāhaṃ paṭipajjissaṃ, gaccha pakkhipath' eva nan ti.
ja472:9.1: Anekatāle narake gambhīre suduruttare pātito giriduggasmiṃ kena tvaṃ tattha nāmarīti.
ja472:10.1: Nāgo jātabalo tattha thāmavā girisānujo paccaggahī maṃ bhogehi tenāhaṃ tattha nāmariṃ.
ja472:11.1: Ehi taṃ paṭinessāmi rājaputta sakaṃ gharaṃ, rajjaṃ kārehi, bhaddan te, kiṃ araññe karissasi.
ja472:12.1: Yathā gilitvā balisaṃ uddhareyya salohitaṃ uddharitvā sukhī assa sukhaṃ passāmi attani. Kin
ja472:13.1: nu tvaṃ balisaṃ brūsi, kiṃ tvaṃ brūsi salohitaṃ, kin nu tvaṃ ubbhataṃ brūsi, tam me akkhāhi pucchito.
ja472:14.1: Kām' āhaṃ balisaṃ brūmi, hatthiassaṃ salohitaṃ, catt' āhaṃ ubbhataṃ brūmi, evaṃ jānāhi khattiyā 'ti.
ja472:15.1: Ciñcamāṇavikā mātā Devadatto ca me pitā Ānando paṇḍito nāgo Sāriputto ca devatā ahaṃ tadā rājaputto,
